The '''''FireRed & LeafGreen'' arc''' (Japanese: '''ファイアレッド・リーフグリーン編''' ''FireRed & LeafGreen arc''), also referred to as '''''The Fifth Chapter''''' (Japanese: '''第五章''' ''The Fifth Chapter''), is the fifth story arc of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, consisting of five volumes. It began serialization in February 2004, and ended in March 2007.

Much like its game counterpart, this arc returns to the characters of {{adv|Red}}, {{adv|Green}}, and {{adv|Blue}}, protagonists of the original {{MangaArc|Red, Green & Blue}} of Pokémon Adventures. Red and Blue are forced to explore the [[Sevii Islands]] to look for {{adv|Professor Oak}} after he's kidnapped by [[Team Rocket]]. Meanwhile, {{adv|Green}} has finally located [[Green's parents|her parents]]; however, just as she is about to meet them, they are swallowed up by a mysterious black hole. Red, Green, and Blue set out to rescue the missing relatives with the help of a former foe, [[Lorelei]], as well as {{adv|Mewtwo}}. At the same time, Team Rocket, headed by {{adv|Giovanni}} and enforced by [[Sird]], [[Carr]], and [[Orm]] of the Three Beasts, is attempting to capture the {{pkmn|category|DNA Pokémon}} {{adv|Deoxys}}, and {{adv|Silver}} arrives in [[Kanto]] to search for his family.

==Important events==
{{spoilers}}
{{main|Timeline of events in Pokémon Adventures#FireRed & LeafGreen arc|Timeline of events in the FireRed & LeafGreen arc of Pokémon Adventures}}
* Half a year has passed since the end of the {{MangaArc|Ruby & Sapphire}}.
* {{adv|Red}} and {{adv|Blue}} return to [[Pallet Town]], and are attacked by {{adv|Deoxys|a mysterious shadow}}.
* {{adv|Green}} is about to meet her parents but suddenly a black hole sucks them in. Green faints and falls off the boat.
* Red and Blue travel with Green to the [[Sevii Islands]], and [[Ultima]] coaches them.
* {{DL|Team Rocket|The Three Beasts}} cause havoc all over Sevii Islands.
* {{adv|Giovanni}} captures Deoxys.
* {{adv|Silver}} meets {{adv|Yellow}} again and reveals that he is searching for his origins.
* Red and {{adv|Mewtwo}} start battling Giovanni and Deoxys on [[Team Rocket airship|Team Rocket's airship]]. 
* Giovanni is revealed to be Silver's father.
* It is revealed that {{i|Ruby|the}} {{i|Sapphire|gems}} Giovanni obtained at the end of the previous arc have been used to simulate [[Hoenn]]'s climate in Kanto.
* It is revealed that there are, in fact, two entities of Deoxys.
* Red, Blue, Green, Yellow, and Silver are turned into stone.

==Party changes==
===Additions===
No Pokémon are obtained in this arc (other than Mewtwo joining Red to battle Giovanni briefly).

===Evolutions===
The following Pokémon evolve:
* Green's {{p|Jigglypuff}} into {{TP|Green|Wigglytuff}} ([[PS288]])
* Green's {{p|Snubbull}} into {{p|Granbull}} ([[PS288]])
* Green's {{p|Nidorina}} into {{p|Nidoqueen}} ([[PS288]])

==Gym Battles==
No Gym Leaders are challenged.
